x: Nuti (T.V.H.), and Browning (Ashcombe) made the pace for the first mile (time 4-56), while the Belgrave men packed splendidly and we had all our six together at half distance.

Nearing the brook Footer moved up with Nuti and Bicknell of Thames Valley just in front of them. After crossing the bridge the long drag up the "Toast-rack" commenced and it was here that Flower and Allum overtook Cohen.
…nd encircling the Deer Enclosure with the runners in the following order: Cohen, Allum, Penny, Jack Flower, Frank Webb, Nuti (T.V.H.), Carter, Dewberry, Morrell, Robertshaw, Smith and Joe Flower.…
